summary: Fixed 1 syntax error and 60+ undefined-name runtime errors across the azazael codebase; identified a structural-corruption class and a false-positive class for future scans.

bug: Broken try/except nesting: 'import arms.support_arms' under bare try, 'import arms.kali_arm' under try with two excepts
root_cause: Copy-paste during import scaffolding; repeated 5x in file
fix: Paired each try with its own except Exception: pass (5 blocks)

bug: sys referenced in fallback is_free_threaded() but not imported
root_cause: except ImportError fallback block imported os + ThreadPoolExecutor but forgot sys

bug: Optional[str] used in _plateau_skip_reason annotation but only Any imported from typing
root_cause: Type import drift after refactor

bug: command referenced in basher gating (GateBash.classify/gate) but never defined in gate_wrapper
root_cause: Refactor split basher check out of function that had 'command' as parameter
fix: command = args[0] if args else '' before the basher check; gate condition uses command

bug: sys.executable used but module imports 'import sys as _sys'
root_cause: Aliased import shadowed the plain name

bug: any(exc in rel_path ...) referenced undefined exc — generator expression missing its 'for exc in' clause
root_cause: Incomplete edit when adding exclude-pattern matching

bug: QueueMessage used in handle_message/_handle_log annotations but not imported
root_cause: Class moved to BasePopupMonitor module; import not updated

bug: rbPath.home() — rbPath never defined
root_cause: Typo for Path

bug: argparse used in main() CLI but never imported
root_cause: Module-level import removed during a cleanup

bug: fuse() called but import was 'from ADLP_FusionCore import CORE, TIER, log_entry, learn'
root_cause: Import list omitted fuse (module exports it at top level)

bug: tk.Label etc used but tkinter never imported
root_cause: Removed commented typing import; tkinter import was inside a conditional that never ran
fix: added 'import tkinter as tk' at module top

bug: import argparse was inside the module docstring (dead text), so main() crashed on NameError
root_cause: Docstring grew over the import during documentation edit

bug: ERRORZ referenced in WORMS dict but no class/import existed in file
root_cause: ERRORZ lives in standalone src/META/ERRORZ.py; METAWORMS never imported it
fix: added _lazy_errorz() helper that imports META.ERRORZ with fallback

bug: torch.from_numpy used but torch only imported in a different method
root_cause: torch import lived in _basic_onnx_export only; analysis path used it without import
fix: added 'import torch' to the llama_cpp try block in the analysis method

bug: dict[str, np.ndarray] annotation + np.* usage in _direct_gguf_to_numpy without numpy import
root_cause: numpy was imported only inside the function body try (too late for the annotation, evaluated at def time)
fix: module-level guarded 'import numpy as np' (np = None on ImportError)

bug: Image.new / ImageDraw.Draw used but PIL never imported
root_cause: PIL import dropped during cleanup

bug: Path used but not imported
root_cause: pathlib import missing

bug: argparse used in main() but not imported
root_cause: import list cleanup removed it

bug: {frame_num:06d} inside a generated-script f-string was NOT escaped ({{}}) — would NameError at runtime when building the script; also os used in outer scope without import
root_cause: Partial f-string escaping: surrounding vars were doubled-braced but this one was missed

bug: add_docstring_to_module, process_directory, main all nested inside generate_docstring with broken indentation; main never reachable
root_cause: Indentation collapse during large edit
fix: full rewrite to module-level functions preserving logic

bug: pathlib.Path used but only Path imported
root_cause: Mixed pathlib.Path vs Path usage

bug: Dict used in annotations but typing import was commented out
root_cause: 'removed — all names have native equivalents' comment was wrong for Dict

bug: threading.active_count() used but threading not imported
root_cause: Import omitted

bug: _draw_glow() called in _render_single_card_frame but never defined
root_cause: Helper was referenced before being written
fix: added _draw_glow(draw, cx, cy, radius, color, alpha) radial-glow helper

bug: from pathlib import Path trapped inside module docstring
root_cause: Docstring grew over import

bug: from pathlib import Path trapped inside docstring
root_cause: same class

bug: Path import trapped in docstring
root_cause: same class

bug: from pathlib import Path trapped in docstring in all 8 make_video variants
root_cause: Template propagation of the same mistake
fix: moved Path import out of docstring in all 8

bug: Path used in except-ImportError fallback but never imported
root_cause: missing import

bug: same Path issue
root_cause: missing import

explanation: Standalone pyflakes flags nx/json/Path/_html/sanitize_label/COMMUNITY_COLORS/write_text_atomic as undefined, but this file is a fragment injected into graphifyy's exporters/html.py by graphify_node_limit_patch.py; the host module defines/imports all of them. Verified: host html.py has all names and _write_huge_html is present.
NmapWorm flagged undefined but is created via globals()[_name] = _make(...) loop
'from X import *' self-imports — intentional pattern for standalone-run modules

bug: ConsistencyChecker class + all methods nested inside ConsistencyIssue with hundreds of spaces of indentation; ConsistencyChecker undefined at module level
evidence: Not imported or referenced anywhere else in src/ or scripts/
recommendation: Either rewrite from scratch (documentation consistency checker) or delete as dead code

lesson: py_compile catches syntax but not undefined names; pyflakes catches undefined names but flags injected fragments and dynamic globals; the combined protocol is: py_compile all -> pyflakes undefined-name filter -> manual AST/string-state verification for f-string escapes and docstring-trapped imports

top_patterns: broken try/except nesting (5 blocks same file)
undefined in annotation because import is function-local (1)
value: train on these patterns to catch them automatically
